name: Morse.expDom
why: Both: a geodesic on an open interval containing [0,1] with γ(0)=q, γ'(0)=v. Project interval (-δ,1+δ), blind any (a,b) with a<0, 1<b (shrink to δ = min(-a, b-1)); the blind extra conditions q ∈ N, v ∈ T_qN follow from the geodesic (IsGeodesicOn.deriv_mem + tsp_eq). On open sets blind and project geodesics coincide (derivWithin = deriv, ⟂ ↔ inner = 0).
